name: Steamwheedle Cartel
summary: The Steamwheedle Cartel is the largest and most influential goblin enterprise operating across modern Azeroth. Fiercely neutral, the cartel governs bustling commercial hubs like Booty Bay, Ratchet, and Gadgetzan, serving Alliance and Horde patrons alike so long as their coin is genuine. Their sprawling operations encompass cross-continental shipping, alchemy, salvaging, and cutthroat mercenary contracting.

sections.title: A Profitable Neutrality
sections.body: Originating from the subterranean goblin capital of Undermine, the Steamwheedle Cartel initially allied with the Old Horde during the Second War, supplying war machines, sappers, and naval engineering. After the dust settled, the cartel's leaders realized that picking sides cost more than it earned. Embracing absolute neutrality, they expanded across both continents, opening trade networks that welcome Alliance and Horde alike. Today, as open tensions simmer, Steamwheedle ports provide vital common ground where anyone with gold can purchase passage, bank resources, and hire local specialists.

sections.title: Ports and Outposts
sections.body: The cartel's influence rests on strategic ports and frontier towns. In Stranglethorn Vale, Baron Revilgaz presides over Booty Bay, a fortified harbor town carved into the cliffs alongside the Blackwater Raiders. Across the Great Sea, Chief Engineer Gazlowe directs Ratchet on the coast of the Barrens, running a deep-water ferry line directly back to Booty Bay. Deep within the deserts of Tanaris lies the boomtown of Gadgetzan, while smaller operations like Steamwheedle Port and remote outposts in Desolace, Azshara, and Stonetalon Mountains secure regional resources.

sections.title: Rivals and Reavers
sections.body: Steamwheedle trade is constantly imperiled by opportunistic cutthroats. In the Southern Seas, the Bloodsail Buccaneers continually menace Booty Bay's naval lanes, while Southsea Freebooters raid the coastlines near Ratchet. On land, the cartel frequently clashes with their corporate arch-rivals, the Venture Company, competing violently for timber rights, oil fields, and shredder technology across Stonetalon and the Barrens. To maintain order and enforce trade contracts, cartel barons routinely hire passing mercenaries to settle grievances with extreme prejudice.

faq.answer: The Steamwheedle Cartel is a massive, neutral goblin trading conglomerate based out of Undermine. They operate several major independent towns across Azeroth—including Booty Bay, Ratchet, and Gadgetzan—offering banking, engineering, transport, and auction houses to all factions.

faq.q: Are the Steamwheedle goblins part of the Horde or Alliance?
faq.answer: Neither. The cartel maintains strict political neutrality. While they previously worked with the Old Horde during the Second War, they severed formal faction allegiances to maximize profit. Today, they happily trade with both the Alliance and the Horde, enforcing peace in their towns with armed bruisers.

faq.q: Which major cities belong to the Steamwheedle Cartel?
faq.answer: Their four principal towns are Booty Bay in southern Stranglethorn Vale, Ratchet on the eastern shore of the Barrens, Gadgetzan in Tanaris, and Everlook in Winterspring. They also maintain smaller hubs like Steamwheedle Port and isolated trading outposts.
Trade Prince Steamwheedle led the cartel during the Second War. Current regional operations are overseen by bosses such as Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay and Chief Engineer Gazlowe in Ratchet.

faq.q: Why are the Steamwheedle goblins enemies with the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a rival goblin enterprise known for cutthroat strip-mining and deforestation. The two factions constantly compete for the same territorial concessions, industrial blueprints, and natural resources across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: What happens if you fight inside a Steamwheedle port?
faq.answer: Steamwheedle towns employ armed goblin bruisers to keep the peace. Attacking other travelers can bring the guards down on you, while killing cartel guards or citizens damages your standing with the cartel.

angles.text: Cartel hubs like Ratchet and Gadgetzan are premier gathering spots for Goblin Engineering schematics, shredder parts, and experimental mechanical components.
For Alliance travelers, Steamwheedle ferry routes and desert outposts provide indispensable waystations and flight paths across remote, Horde-heavy wilderness.
While Gazlowe and his crew maintain historic working relationships with the orcs of Durotar, the cartel still demands cold hard coin for their services and neutrality.
The lawless fringes of Booty Bay and Ratchet offer bountiful employment for thieves, lockpicks, and covert contractors willing to fleece pirates and rivals alike.
